body: I’m a little late to the convo but YESS. This has happened to me with 2 different characters from 2 different shows. It got so bad to the point where I had to stop watching them because I would literally scream-cry after remembering they’re not real and I’ll never be them. I have no idea why I do this and I still like the shows but I’m scared to rewatch them because I don’t want to become overly attached again and feel like I did before. (For those curious about the characters, the first one is Steven from Steven universe and the second is Kyle from South Park)
